# Rover Operations Handbook

## Organisation

The **Rover Operations Control Centre** (ROCC) operates the rover from the ground in Turin.
The **Science Team** proposes observations for every sol and reviews the returned data.

## Planning

The **Tactical Planning Cycle** turns science requests into commands for the next sol.
Every cycle produces one **Activity Plan** that the Rover Operations Control Centre uploads for a single sol.
